text: {"lessons":["My account fell from NT$104,325 to NT$91,489, but these short-term changes do not tell me what prices will do next.","I made no trades throughout, so I should review whether my holdings and diversification still fit my risk tolerance rather than assume doing nothing is always best.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should make deliberate, plan-based decisions and avoid trading just to escape recent declines."]}
